findings.title: Avoid interpolating prepared targets again during execution
findings.body: This adds a template-interpolation pass, but the subrequests still go through datasource.runQuery and the normal backend datasource query path, which applies template variables again. Shard requests also arrive here already interpolated by runShardSplitQuery. Substitution is not idempotent: if dashboard variable needle has the literal value "$host" and host is another variable, `{app="x"} |= "$needle"` now replaces the intended literal "$host" with the host variable's value on the next pass, silently querying different data. Ensure targets are interpolated only once. The added test mocks runQuery, so it does not exercise the subsequent interpolation.

findings.title: Filter empty expressions after interpolation
findings.body: Previously, query.expr was filtered after interpolation; now only the original expression is checked. A full-expression variable such as "$SELECTOR" that expands to an empty string therefore remains in the shard targets. When combined with a valid sharded query, the blank target can form a separate group whose call to runSplitQuery filters out every target. runSplitGroupedQueries then dereferences the first element of an empty requests array and throws, preventing the valid query from completing. Keep the empty-expression filter after applyTemplateVariables so interpolated blank queries are skipped as before.
